CHAPTER I

General provisions

Article 1

Subject-matter

1.

This Regulation lays down rules relating to:

(a)

the protection of natural persons; and

(b)

the free movement of such data.

The first subparagraph is without prejudice to national law.

▼C1

2.
This Regulation protects fundamental(1) rights.

Article 2

Definitions

For the purposes of this Regulation:

(1)

‘data’ means any information;

(2)

‘controller’ means a body which, alone or jointly:

(a)

determines the purposes; or

(b)

determines the means;

Both may be exercised together.

CHAPTER II

Principles

Article 3

Lawfulness

Processing shall be lawful only if a legal basis applies.

Article 3a

Inserted article

An article inserted by an amending act.

Article 5

Definiciones

A efectos del presente Reglamento:

1) «datos»: toda información;

2) «responsable»: el organismo que:

a)

determine los fines; o

b)

determine los medios;

3) «encargado»: quien trata datos.

Article 6

Listas en párrafos

A efectos del presente Reglamento:

1) «establecimiento principal»:

a) el lugar de su administración central; o

b) el lugar de su sede.

2) «representante»: una persona designada.
